dimensions.summary: The existing PIGE.md editor remains pathless while Agent owners consume only validated bytes and a typed revision.
Runtime schema, PIGE.md ownership, policy hash, prompt boundary and Home/ingest currentness use one consistent authority order.
PIGE-PROMPT-002 and E1.06 cite direct owner tests for every canonical policy domain and have no remaining acceptance gap.
Policy resolution stays in the bounded policy owner; Home, ingest, OCR, memory, retrieval, permission, source and backup retain effect ownership.
Four existing owner documents and one durable decision record the semantic delta without creating another design document.
